subtitle: Cinema Clarity, Offline Music Library & Arcade Daily
changes: Fixed Video Vault playback clarity by enforcing a fully opaque black stage and isolated video compositor, preventing the personalized website background and glass effects from showing through the player
Kept Cinema Atmosphere Sync around the outside of the Vault player rather than overlaying video pixels; added original-frame / fill-and-crop presentation and a focused single-player layout

Added a genuine browser-local Saved Music Library inside Media Theater, allowing visitors to save imported audio, restore stored songs into the listening queue on return, and remove saved copies without deleting original files
Added opt-in saved-song startup in Media Theater: select a stored track, toggle attempted playback at site opening on or off, and use a one-tap fallback when Chrome/Safari blocks audible autoplay
Introduced Media Theater wide-screen layout and frame-fit controls while preserving existing playlists, original playback, visualizers, A–B loops and media-to-Reactor handoff
Expanded Animation Forge with rapid three-, five- and eight-second GIF clip windows from the loaded video playhead, preserving advanced export settings and memory preflight
Added an Arcade Nexus daily challenge and streak tracker across the three existing playable games, without resetting past scores or restoring retired studios
Retained 18 active spaces, PC/iPhone adaptive layouts, user media privacy and browser-local storage, with updated settings backups, regression tests and rollbacks
Preserved the existing GitHub Pages deployment and direct GitHub-to-Discord release announcement automation without switching to BotGhost
